purpose: find candidate skills on the web BEFORE adding; output ranked candidates, never installs
use_when: Finding candidate skills on the web with skills.sh search before adding
Discovering agent skills for a topic via GitHub SKILL.md repo search
Ranking new skill candidates with license, installs, and freshness for user confirmation
Discover agent skills for a topic (RLS, postgres, PDF handling) before adding them
do_not_use_when: Installing or adding anything (candidates go to user/skillhub add for confirmation)
Answering the underlying task itself (use that domain skill, not the finder)
scope: Only touch files the task names; everything else read-only.
disambiguator: Finding NEW skills to add -> this. Picking AMONG registered skills -> skill-router. Stealth browsing or scraping pages -> obscura.
